title: Italian Vegetable Biryani
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired take on the classic Indian dish, featuring fresh vegetables and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Biryani Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the biryani spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked sausage and vegetable mixture to a large pot of cooked rice.
Mix well and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
